description: An open-source cost controller for AI agent loops — stops a loop when it's actually converged and rolls back before it degrades, instead of running to a fixed max_iterations cap. Real-time loop-gain (Aβ) bands + best-so-far rollback. Adapters for LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, OpenAI Agents, and Claude Agent SDK; raw API for custom stacks.
